subject: Engineer roster and demo runbook scheduling
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: engineer roster & demo runbook (proposed 60–90min)

Alex — great to meet today, thanks for the detailed product context. Quick recap and proposed next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical runthrough with our ML/infra and platform engineers to validate performance/cost assumptions and walk through the integration surface.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 10/06, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 10/07, 13:00–14:30
- Thu 10/08, 08:30–10:00

Suggested attendees from your side:
- Alex Hart — Product/CTO (overview + success criteria)
- Priya Desai — Security/Compliance (SOC/controls Qs)
- An infra/ML engineer who owns model orchestration (optional)

From our side: Connor (ML infra lead), Aditya (solutions engineer) and I will run the session. Draft agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m — goals + current infra overview (Ellum)
2) 20–30m — ML/serving architecture + latency/cost targets
3) 20–30m — demo: inference pipeline + KV/prefix caching tradeoffs
4) 10–20m — integration checklist, rollouts, and open Qs

Attachments: post-discovery-recap.pdf (summary) and precall questionnaire (precall-questionnaire.md). Can you confirm preferred slot and who from Ellum will join for the security and infra sections? If none of the windows work, share 2–3 alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Calendar poll: https://cal.redwood.com/pick-slot?token=abcd-ellum-2027

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[ATTACHMENT: post-discovery-recap.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[ATTACHMENT: precall-questionnaire.md (Markdown, 4KB)]

From: Alex Hart <alex.hart@ellumhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@ellumhealth.com>, Ellum Health Sales Ops <salesops@ellumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer roster & demo runbook (proposed 60–90min)

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear agenda. Wed 10/07, 13:00–14:30 PT works best for us. I’ll block the time.

Attendees from our side:
- Alex Hart (me) — Product/CTO
- Priya Desai — Head of Security (she wants to cover SOC 2 scoping briefly)
- Imran Ahmed — Platform Engineer (will own the integration)

Two quick asks from Priya: can you include a brief slide or runbook section showing how Redwood surfaces audit logs and KMS integration? Also — our procurement team would like a high-level SOW/estimate before the deep dive; sales ops copied.

I’ll accept the calendar invite once the slot is confirmed.

— Alex
Alex Hart
CTO, Ellum Health
alex.hart@ellumhealth.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Hart <alex.hart@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@ellumhealth.com>, Ellum Health Sales Ops <salesops@ellumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: engineer roster & demo runbook (proposed 60–90min)

Perfect — Wed 10/07 13:00–14:30 PT is locked on our side. I’ve created a 90-minute invite and included the pre-read attachments.

Connor will cover ML/infra specifics (KV cache, batching, quantization tradeoffs). Aditya will handle the live demo and ops integration checklist. Per Priya’s request, I added a 5–7 minute run-through item showing audit logs and KMS options under the integration checklist section. We’ll also include a single-slide SOW/estimate placeholder for procurement to reference; sales ops, feel free to update after the session.

Updated agenda (90m):
- 13:00–13:10 — Welcome & goals (Alex + Lauren)
- 13:10–13:35 — ML infra architecture + perf targets (Connor)
- 13:35–14:05 — Live demo: inference flow + configuration knobs (Aditya)
- 14:05–14:12 — Audit logs / KMS / compliance notes (Lauren + Priya Qs)
- 14:12–14:25 — Integration checklist & rollout options (group)
- 14:25–14:30 — Action items / next steps

Pre-call asks (short):
- Priya: any SOC 2 scoping doc or list of required artifacts?
- Imran: rough notes on current model-serving infra (k8s, autoscaling, GPUs, endpoint patterns)

Attachments reattached. I’ve also added a short paste of our standard audit-log example to the invite description.

See you both on Wednesday.

— Lauren
[ATTACHMENT: post-discovery-recap.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[ATTACHMENT: precall-questionnaire.md (Markdown, 4KB)]

Thanks — I’ll be on the call and will bring the following artifacts to the demo:
- short benchmark slide (p50/p95 latency by seq len)
- KV/prefix caching examples (two short notebooks)
- a short runbook snippet for failure modes and graceful fallback (for your SREs)

Priya — I’ll also drop a small note in the invite description showing where the audit logs appear in the Console. If there are specific log retention/settings you want to see, ping me and I’ll prepare that slice.

Connor
